notablePrerequisites:
You have the initiative.
You have completed a dungeon.
description:
At the beginning of your end step, Safana triggers.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Safana's ability.
Resolve the copy of Safana's ability, creating three Treasure tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two Treasure tokens, untapping Lithoform Engine.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a Treasure token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.
